description:
`compute_mother_encoding` in the 5G NR LDPC module carries two literal copies of the same pivot-find, row-swap, and full-column-eliminate kernel, applied to different column ranges. Factor the kernel out so the algorithm exists once.

## Background

The duplicated block is 28 lines and appears at `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/nr_5g/mod.rs:753`. The sibling encoder in the same crate, `richardson_urbanke.rs`, already delegates its elimination to the shared core routine, so the copies here are the outlier rather than the convention.

The two call sites differ only in the column range they sweep and the pivot bookkeeping they carry forward, which is what the extracted helper takes as parameters.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A single private helper performs the pivot-find, row-swap, and column-eliminate pass, and `compute_mother_encoding` calls it for both column ranges.
- [hard] REQ-02: No copy of the pivot/swap/eliminate kernel remains in the module.
- [hard] REQ-03: Encoding output is unchanged for every 5G NR base graph and lifting size already covered by the crate's tests.
- [hard] REQ-04: The workspace test suite, clippy with warnings denied, and formatting all pass.
title: Extract the repeated RREF column pass in 5G NR mother encoding
